title: HOY Region-2 Replication Proof

claimBoundary.note: A pre-registered test design is not evidence that HOY has already replicated a second region.

region1T0.scopeRule: The defined Mar Menor region is the full nine-area operating footprint below. It is explicitly not limited to La Manga del Mar Menor and Cabo de Palos.

areas.area: Los Urrutias / Estrella de Mar / Los Nietos
San Pedro del Pinatar / Lo Pagán
Santiago de la Ribera / San Javier

historicalEfficiency.rule: No faster/cheaper Region-2 claim may be made against invented or estimated Region-1 effort data.

region2Candidate.name: Bernkastel-Kues / Mittelmosel
region2Candidate.rule: Freeze the exact geography and cohort before first Region-2 data ingest.

stages.name: Pre-registered design
criteria: claim rules frozen before Region-2 execution

stages.name: Region boundary freeze
criteria: measurement clock start recorded before ingest

stages.name: Technical portability
criteria: region differences expressed as config/data or reusable adapters

stages.name: Supply replication cohort
criteria: at least 50 published businesses in the frozen cohort
100% direct provenance references are registered before buyer-facing publication
no quality gate is weakened to hit speed

stages.name: First-party merchant replication
criteria: at least 10 distinct businesses reach verified operator membership or factual operator confirmation
F1 factual confirmation is not presented as rights clearance
R1 receipts count only when active accepted terms actually exist

stages.name: Economic replication
criteria: at least 3 distinct external businesses have reconciled settled recurring payments under ACQ-03 rules
at least 1 independent renewal is observed
one-off Highlight revenue is excluded from recurring MRR

stages.name: Efficiency measurement
criteria: Region-1 comparison stays UNKNOWN until Region-1 historical effort is reconstructed comparably

stages.name: Buyer-grade regional repeatability
criteria: no buyer-grade repeatability claim relies on lower standards or unmeasured effort

qualityRatchet: Privacy, consent, security and public-runtime gates may not be weakened
Unknown source rights fail closed and all direct provenance references must be registered
Accessibility uses the same structured state and verification model
Merchant outcomes follow the ACQ-04 confirmation ladder
Paying-business and recurring-revenue claims follow ACQ-03 settled-payment rules
A faster launch obtained by reducing data quality, rights discipline or QA does not count as replication success

claimRules.REPLICATED: Only after R2-3, R2-4 and R2-5 are evidenced with the quality ratchet intact.
claimRules.EFFICIENTLY_REPLICATED: Only after comparable Region-1 and Region-2 effort/cost data show lower Region-2 effort without quality regression.

nextActions: Reconstruct Region-1 historical founder hours, operator hours, cash spend and calendar milestones only from auditable evidence; keep unknown if not reconstructable.
Freeze the exact Region-2 geography and launch cohort before any ingest.
Instrument Region-2 effort from minute one instead of reconstructing it later.
Do not lift Contact Freeze or start outreach through ACQ-06.
